verdict.rationale: Martin's own docs describe a search capability that queries multiple search engines, so web-grounded answers are a first-party feature. Nothing in the pack shows that answers include citations or links back to their sources, and there is no hands-on corroboration of answer quality or freshness. Missing for 10: documented source citations/links in answers, detail on how results are grounded and kept current, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can get answers grounded in current web results with citations back to the sources

citations.quote: Martin syncs with multiple search engines to find you the most relevant information.
